briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 escalate frontier model race amid record funding

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with multiple frontier releases this month as compute constraints tighten. Major labs push multi-agent systems while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous capabilities. Funding remains robust despite economic headwinds.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning benchmarks, while Anthropic's Claude 4 and xAI's Grok-4 launched within days. DeepSeek-V3 and Meta's Llama-4 updates focus on efficiency. Multi-agent coordination emerges as the key differentiator.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins targeting high-risk deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell shipments ramp while TSMC expands Arizona fabs for AI chips. Google and Microsoft announce joint 100k H100 cluster expansions in Europe.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like DialectForge become mandatory for safety-critical deployments by 2028?
